$comment: Praxis's own declaration of which shipped enforcement gates it runs against itself.
This is NOT host-facing tooling and NOT a path allowlist — it declares, per script,
whether Praxis executes that gate in its own CI, and why not when it does not.
Every scripts/check-*.sh on disk must appear here exactly once; a `runs: false` entry
must carry a non-empty `reason`. Both invariants are enforced by validate-plugin.sh
check #16, so a newly added probe cannot be silently omitted from the split.
`note` is optional and records that a gate's clean verdict is vacuous — it executes,
but scans no matching files — so the build is never read as a stronger claim than it is.

gates.note: Vacuous pass: Praxis ships no runtime source under the probe's scan paths, so a clean verdict proves the script executes, not that the Configurable anchor holds on real code.
Activates whenever an active sprint's footprint declares a dependsOnContracts entry. Praxis declares no seams today, so it reports zero dependencies rather than being absent.

Runs unconditionally so its verdict is visible on every build. With no Major-tier sprint on the branch it reports the empty-input verdict; the populated path is exercised when a Major sprint is present.
Informational by design — always exits 0 (ADR.260720.03). Runs so the escape-hatch count is visible in the build, never to gate it.

gates.reason: Targets a product test suite in the 11 scanned languages; Praxis ships none. The only in-tree matches are the deliberate dirty fixtures under scripts/__fixtures__/, which test-probes.sh already asserts must exit 1 — a stronger proof of this probe than a scoped vacuous pass. Adding an exclusion flag was rejected: it would change a host-facing probe's scan semantics to solve Praxis's own fixture layout.
Same as check-no-skipped-tests.sh: targets a product test suite Praxis does not ship, and its only in-tree matches are the deliberate dirty fixtures that test-probes.sh asserts must exit 1.

gates.note: Vacuous pass: no runtime source under the scan paths, and this wave declares no seams. Proves the script executes, not that the Observable anchor holds on real code.
Vacuous pass: Praxis declares no *.ports.* files, so the probe finds 0 port files. Proves execution, not parity on real code.
Vacuous pass: no runtime source under the scan paths and no boundary calls. Proves the script executes, not that the Resilient anchor holds on real code.

Self-skips today because Praxis declares no .seam-contracts.json. Declared `runs: true` rather than n/a so the gate activates automatically the moment Praxis declares its first seam, instead of the exemption going stale.

Activates whenever two or more active sprints declare a Sprint Footprint. Reports a skip verdict when fewer than two do — the footprint artifact is deliberately not mandatory before concurrent dispatch happens.
Activates whenever conforming sprint files exist under docs/product/sprints/. Reports a skip verdict when none are active.
Vacuous pass: no request path and no runtime source under the scan paths. Proves the script executes, not that the Horizontally-scalable anchor holds on real code.
